source: Downloads/206c7a965974423c9b603e52fa06f89c.MP4 (@raycfu, 'How to do motion design with Claude Opus 5.5', AirDropped 12 Oct 2026). 720x1280, 30 fps, HEVC, 58.7 s, AAC 44.1 kHz stereo (speech to 56.9 s). Copy in _source/talking-head-split-raycfu.MP4 (gitignored).
method: ffmpeg scene detection (threshold 0.08 and 0.25), per-frame region statistics at 30 fps (half-resolution numpy pass, 0.13 GB peak), caption white-pixel masks, local Whisper large-v3-turbo (mlx 4-bit, 0.9 GB peak, 12 s) for word times, ebur128 loudness, frames viewed in contact sheets and at full size.

layout.talker: full bleed, one continuous take, two digital framings (wide: standing figure small in the lower half, close: head and shoulders about 1.7x)

cards.transition: hard cut, no animation, square corners, no shadow
cards.content: real screen recordings and screenshots (Claude chat UI, product sites, code, charts), motion inside the card, tool logos (FFmpeg, Playwright) float above the card

captions.font_nearest: high-contrast condensed Didone serif, close to Ivy Presto Display or Canela. Nearest bundled OFL face: Playfair Display weight 600 with tracking -0.035 em
captions.shadow: soft black, about 3 px down, 6 px blur, 60 percent
captions.animation: hard swap, no word highlight, no fade
captions.highlight: none in the captions, gold only in the title

title.text: How to do / motion design with / Claude Opus 5.5
title.exit: hard cut when the first card arrives

colour.grade: none, natural phone footage, grey room
colour.card_backgrounds: white or off-white UI, black title card, saturated orange poster

end.content: platform end screen: Instagram icon and handle over the picture dimmed to 25 percent, caption 'tech and AI' fading
end.note: added by the platform on export, not part of the creator's edit

overlays_not_part_of_style: Instagram glyph and @raycfu handle, drifting between top right and left of the card in the first 55 s

audio.music_bed: none (gaps fall to digital silence, p10 -91 dB)
audio.sound_effects: none (4 non-speech onsets, all breaths or the end)
